about: Per-surface feature status, pinned to source anchors. scripts/parity-check.mjs fails when a present/partial anchor stops matching and warns when every anchor of a missing surface starts matching. Anchors are [repo path, JS regex (multiline)]. Seeded from the 2026-10-14 parity audit (iOS and Mac Studio are the reference); each anchor was checked against main that day. Update a status in the same commit that changes it.
